newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T off as U.S. settlement euphoria ebbs.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T off as U.S. settlement euphoria ebbs.

text.p: Shares in B.A.T Industries Plc extended Thursday's fall, shedding 8p to 531p by 1336 GMT on Friday, as euphoria over a possible settlement in U.S. legal claims waned, analysts said.

Profit-taking took 2p off the stock by Thursday's close and during the New York session credit-rating agency Standard & Poor's said it may cut the debt ratings of tobacco companies with U.S. litigation exposure, citing B.A.T among others.
"News of settlement negotiations was new and there were two days of sharp rises but now we're seeing a bit of profit-taking," said BZW analyst, Nyren Scott-Malden.
"It is clear that there are a lot of obstacles to a settlement and it is not clear that it will come but if it does it will be good news," he said.
